drums.tags: Heavy metal featuring a prominent, distorted electric bass guitar playing a syncopated, percussive riff. The bass tone is characterized by high-gain saturation and a clanky, metallic attack. A drum kit follows with a steady, mid-tempo groove, utilizing a crisp snare and a resonant kick drum. The arrangement is minimalist, focusing on the interplay between the rhythmic bass line and the straightforward drum pattern. 100 BPM. 4/4 time signature. Key of E minor.

bass.tags: Percussion ensemble piece featuring a variety of hand drums and body percussion. The track is built around a syncopated, polyrhythmic structure with a steady pulse. It features low-tuned tom-toms or floor toms providing a resonant, thumping bass foundation, while higher-pitched hand drums like congas or bongos execute rapid, sixteenth-note patterns and sharp accents. Handclaps and rhythmic chest-slapping add organic, mid-range textures. The tempo is 120 BPM in 4/4 time. The arrangement focuses on rhythmic interplay and dynamic builds, with sections alternating between sparse, singular drum hits and dense, layered tribal-style grooves. No melodic or harmonic instruments are present.
